## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix preview path containment before merge because the helper can disclose text from files outside the selected home directory.

## Changes

The pull request adds a 200-character text preview, a helper that returns the path to `settings.toml`, and tests for both helpers.

## Critical

- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Check resolved paths before reading previews — A relative path that traverses above `home` or a symlink inside `home` that points to an outside file passes the guard. `is_relative_to()` compares path components without resolving either case. — Either input can expose up to 200 characters from a file outside the selected home directory. — Fix: Resolve both paths before checking containment, then read from the resolved candidate.

## Important

- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Limit how much text the preview reads — Previewing a valid text file larger than available memory can exhaust memory because `read_text()` loads the entire file before the 200-character slice. — A sufficiently large text file can cause the process to terminate when a user requests its preview. — Fix: Open the file with a context manager and read at most 200 characters.
